Strip keywords

Any sentence containing one of these is removed on add. Case is ignored. Prompts you edited by hand are left alone.

Find & replace list

When you paste a prompt, every pair found in it is listed so you can choose which to replace. Whole words only; case is ignored.

Suffix

While Suffix is on, this text is added to the end of every prompt on export. Your prompts are not changed.

Trigger presets

The active trigger is put at the start of every exported prompt. If the prompt already contains one of the "already described" phrases, only the token is added.
